digest.component_or_area: plan-review reviewer prompts and criteria routing
propositions: Dual vocabulary ('Success Criteria' and 'Acceptance Criteria') in reviewer prompts causes pooling of distinct rubric checks and confuses the LLM about conceptual boundaries

All occurrences of 'Success Criteria' must be renamed to 'Acceptance Criteria' in reviewer prompts, routing index, and regenerated criteria guide, with three sites deliberately excluded (T2 generic English, dod_uncertifiable wording)
The routing index edit rotates the regver stamp, which invalidates outstanding plan-review attestations as stale, but is safe only after grandfathering prerequisite ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e merges
Bare SC tokens in plan_review_G3.md ('THREE SC-CONTRADICTION PATTERNS' and 'SC says zero matches') require hand edits to 'AC' to avoid false-positive replacement of 'O-RAN-SC'
Regeneration of the criteria guide must be performed via the registry command and verified to preserve the GENERATED banner and the one deliberately-excluded T2 phrase
